profile.headline: Computer Engineer | Robotics, Automation & Embedded Systems
profile.summary:
I'm a Computer Engineering student with a passion for creating systems that bridge hardware and software. My focus lies at the intersection of robotics and embedded systems, where I work on projects ranging from 3D pose estimation for sports performance to a LEGO sorting robot. 

Through research roles and hands-on engineering projects, I’ve developed skills in:
- Computer Vision: OpenCV, MediaPipe, edge/line detection, color masking, object detection
- Robotics: ROS, odometry, state estimation, PID controllers, system integration and deployment
- Embedded Systems & Hardware: ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, FreeRTOS, sensor integration, PWM motor control, memory management, communication protocols (I2C/SPI/UART)
- Data Analysis & AI: Scikit-Learn, YOLO, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, data cleaning and visualization

I’m always looking to connect with others in robotics, and embedded systems. Feel free to reach out!

Email: kendalwilliams05@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/KWill55
Google Drive Projects Portfolio: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EBH_aR2-niwv60g03GeoBgQeokANzlVt

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: I’m excited to share that I’ve started a new position at Autonomous Solutions, Inc! I’m grateful for the opportunity to work in the robotic and autonomous vehicle industry while I grow my skills in problem solving, engineering, and embedded systems. I can’t wait to learn from such a talented team and contribute to the exciting work being done at ASI.

positions.title: Robotic Vision Lab Research Assistant
positions.description:
Robotic Vision Lab Research Assistant to Dr Lee, BYU Robotic Vision Lab:
- Led development of a multi-camera stereo-vision system for basketball free-throw biomechanics analysis, from data capture through performance metrics
- Designed and implemented a 3-camera pipeline for 3D pose estimation and ball tracking, including camera calibration/synchronization, data preprocessing, and trajectory analysis
- Extracted kinematic features from pose and ball data and applied classical machine learning models (KNN, Decision Tree, SVM) to analyze shot consistency and performance trends
- Led Chip Camp ML and microcontroller teams, teaching 100+ middle school students 
- Validated YOLO models through BYU’s supercomputer and Python scripting for AI Football project
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Vision · OpenCV · Python (Programming Language) · Machine Learning · Data Analysis · pose estimation · Stereo Vision

company.name: BYU Ira A. Fulton College of Engineering

positions.title: BYU Football Student Video Manager
positions.description:
- Operate JVC and PTZ systems in live practice and game environments to deliver quality footage for BYU coaches and players in order to improve performance. 
- Recognized with MVP Filmer Award for exceptional performance and dedication during 2024 Fall Camp

positions.title: CRLA Certified Global Student Support Specialist
positions.description:
Peer Educator (CRLA Certified)
Supported and mentored 300+ students from diverse backgrounds in BYU Independent Study and BYU Online High School, primarily in high school mathematics. Provided personalized academic support across 8 online courses, helping students build strong study habits, set goals, and successfully complete coursework.

Key Contributions
- Instruction & Communication: Clearly explained complex math concepts through effective, student-centered communication.
- Student Support: Fostered a supportive, patient learning environment, particularly for students struggling with math.
- Academic Skills Development: Led one-on-one appointments focused on study strategies and goal-setting tailored to individual needs.
- Engagement & Mentorship: Maintained regular communication with 300+ students via email, offering encouragement, course updates, and academic guidance.
- Leadership & Training: Trained and mentored new employees; instructed staff on Orion, Outlook Mail Merge, Excel, Box, ConnexEd, Teams, CRM, Buzz, and Canvas; recognized as Employee of the Month.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Mathematics · Mentoring · Team Building · Problem Solving

positions.title: BYU Culinary Support Center Bakery Assistant
positions.description:
In the CSC bakery, we were responsible for producing quality baked goods for a number
of outlets that we sent our products to. BYU has a reputation for the food it produces, so
we were expected to keep things up to a high standard. I assisted in the entire process of
making dough, freezing, counting, and baking a variety of products including rolls,
hamburger buns, and donuts. I gained valuable experience in working independently and
with time management. Often there were multiple assignments at the same time, and we
had the responsibility of planning out when we would perform which ones in order to be
the most efficient.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Baking · Teamwork · Time Management

positions.title: Line Cook
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · On-site
positions.description:
I became proficient at running the entire line of Cafe Rio. I gained experience working
with customers in a high stress environment. Time management was key in succeeding in
this role, as every second matters to the customers that we serve. I also gained
communication and teamwork skills, as I worked side by side with coworkers to achieve
our common goal of assisting the customers together. I learned how to be friendly to
customers and to make them feel welcome in our restaurant.
positions.insights: Skills: Teamwork · Time Management · Customer Service

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered weekly in The Just One Project's "community markets", "pop up and give mobile markets", "farmers markets" and as a delivery driver. I assisted in packing food into bags, loading pallets of food onto the box trucks, and hand delivering food and providing assistance to the elderly in need in communities throughout the Las Vegas Metropolitan area. Volunteering here has been such a wonderful experience. I love the people I've met here and seeing the good that this company provides to those in need. I'm grateful to have had the chance to be a part of such an important cause!

At Make a Wish, I was able to provide service to children with critical illnesses in the Las Vegas area. I helped by making signs, setting up decorations, and preparing in other ways for wish reveals for these wish kids to get them excited about their wish coming true. I also helped grant wishes for these children by assembling wishes, organizing materials, and helping in a variety of other ways. I love the good that Make a Wish does for these children.

projects.title: LEGO Brick Sorter Capstone Project
projects.description:
- Designed a robotic LEGO sorting system using a gantry, conveyor, and vacuum pick-and-place arm
- Built Python control software for motion planning and keyboard-driven commands 
- Developing vibrating V-funnels, conveyor belts, and servo mechanisms for piece isolation and sorting
- Integrating YOLO-based vision for piece detection, system coordination, and piece classification
- Future work: inventory management, routing, and system integration

projects.title: Freethrow Optimization
projects.description: Freethrow optimization project for Robotic Vision Lab at BYU.

volunteerExperience.description: Volunteered weekly in The Just One Project's "community markets", "pop up and give mobile markets", "farmers markets" and as a delivery driver. I assisted in packing food into bags, loading pallets of food onto the box trucks, and hand delivering food and providing assistance to the elderly in need in communities throughout the Las Vegas Metropolitan area. Volunteering here has been such a wonderful experience. I love the people I've met here and seeing the good that this company provides to those in need. I'm grateful to have had the chance to be a part of such an important cause!

At Make a Wish, I was able to provide service to children with critical illnesses in the Las Vegas area. I helped by making signs, setting up decorations, and preparing in other ways for wish reveals for these wish kids to get them excited about their wish coming true. I also helped grant wishes for these children by assembling wishes, organizing materials, and helping in a variety of other ways. I love the good that Make a Wish does for these children.
